label: late-episode rare-transition signal: up at a1->S2, down at a2->S1
explanation: Raw candidate n of unit 11 sits near +1 for most of the episode and falls steeply over trials 70-99 (timing alone gives R^2 0.92). All history effects are confined to that late window, so every term is scaled by a linear late ramp clip((ep_trial-60)/40). At D2 the unit rises after a rare a1->S2 transition (weight +0.49) and falls after a rare a2->S1 transition (-0.55); common transitions have almost no effect. At the following D1/GO it is lowered after a previous a1->S2 trial, more so if that trial was rewarded (-0.13 x (1+prev_reward)), and raised at GO after a previous a2->S1 trial (+0.24). Ideal-observer belief (belief_lo) adds about nothing (<0.01). Test R^2 beyond timing 0.19 (dev 0.19), which matches or beats the additive all ceiling (0.18) and the all-observed ceiling (0.13). Observed-only loses nothing compared with the earlier model value/policy explanation (policy and value deciles alone score 0.04 each). Most of the remaining variance is finer timing, not history: a within-decile ep_trial ramp for deciles 7-9 alone adds 0.40 on dev and reaches 0.57 together with these terms. It was left out because it is timing. Not causal.
